text:
simon_infra: FYI - need quick approval for a vendor slab deal for H100 capacity in us-west2. Details below.

maria_devops: Can you paste the numbers? what's the monthly commit and term?

simon_infra: Proposed: 24-month commit, 40 H100 GPUs reserved, blended rate ~$5.50/GPU-hr equivalent. Estimated monthly commit ~$240k. Break-even vs on-demand in ~7 months. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example-link

aj_finance: ping @aj_finance for budget. We need cost center and headcount offset. We only have $1.2M left in infra Q3 capex.

leo_eng: Do we need all 40 in us-west2? Could split 24 in us-west2, 16 in eu-west1 to match ML traffic and reduce egress. Latency-critical infra is us-west only; batch training can be EU.

simon_infra: Good point. Vendor offers regional slab discounts but cross-region resharding adds ops. Proposal: 30 US / 10 EU. Net monthly ~210k after regional discount.

rachel_ops: Any SLA/throughput guarantees? Also what's the fallback if we scale down? Early termination fees?

simon_infra: SLA 99.9% with 4hr RTO for host failures, early termination 30% of remaining commit. We can include burst-on-demand for spikes. Included monitoring and a 2-month free trial window.

aj_finance: Need a CAPEX vs OPEX analysis. Send runbook cost model + forecast for 24 months. cc @cfo.

simon_infra: Attached cost model in sheet + runbook link. Quick calc snippet:
```
commit_gpus=40
monthly_cost=commit_gpus*6000 # approx
on_demand_spend=estimated_hours*price
```

maria_devops: Ops note: switching to 8-bit quantized models reduces effective GPU need by ~25%. Could renegotiate to 30 H100 reserved with option to buy add-ons.

aj_finance: Okay. I'll prepare a one-pager for exec sign-off. @simon_infra pls update the spreadsheet with split 30/10 and projected savings. Targeting approval by EOD Friday :calendar:

deploy-bot: Deployment window proposed: 2026-04-15 02:00-05:00 UTC if commit approved.

simon_infra: Updated the sheet and added risk register. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
